title: A Wreck for the Passage
premise: When her estranged father's expedition upriver goes silent, Kestrel Reyes is hired by the concession company to retrieve it before the permits expire in nine days. She finds the camp intact but the team scattered, guarding a discovery that could rewrite the region's history — and that the company intends to bury or steal. Torn between love for a father who chose the work over her and duty to bring everyone home, Kestrel must decide what deserves to survive: the find, the truth, or the people. In the end she burns the site's location from every record, leads the survivors out through flood season, and lets the river keep its secret.
about_author: Astrid Almeida spent a decade leading river expeditions through remote concessions before turning to fiction, and her prose carries the mud, silence, and radio static of those years. She writes from a houseboat whose location she declines to disclose.

chapters.title: Nine Days of Static
chapters.summary: Kestrel's POV. Hired by the concession company as a 'logistics consultant,' she flies upriver with a fixer named Ovidio who reports to someone above him. Flashbacks braid in her last fight with her father. The emotional beat is resentment sharpening into dread as the radio stays dead and the pilot refuses to land past the second bend.

chapters.title: The Camp That Kept Its Mouth Shut
chapters.summary: Kestrel finds the base camp orderly but abandoned mid-meal, one member dead of an apparent fall, and her father gone inland with two others. A survivor, Dr. Imani Cole, warns her the company's earlier survey team came back wrong — rich, silent, changed. Rising tension: Kestrel realizes Ovidio's satellite phone transmits more than it receives.

chapters.title: What the River Was Paid to Forget
chapters.summary: Kestrel tracks her father to a submerged temple complex exposed by drought, where he guards the find — records proving the company manufactured the concession's legal history. Climax: Ovidio's backers arrive by gunboat; her father, choosing the truth over escape, is shot holding the archive. Kestrel must choose between saving the evidence and saving the living.

chapters.title: Concession
chapters.summary: Kestrel scatters the archive into the flooding river, fakes the site's coordinates, and walks the wounded out ahead of the permit deadline, letting Ovidio believe his employers won. Resolution: home again, she answers her father's old letters at last, understanding that some inheritances are meant to be surrendered. Quiet grief, hard-won peace.
